# Arguments: zin_arg_value (number).
zin_tritons_add_piracy = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_tritons_seas_init } }
		set_global_flag = zin_tritons_seas_init
		set_variable = { global.zin_tritons_piracy = 35 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_tritons_piracy = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = global.zin_tritons_piracy
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
	zin_tritons_refresh_seas = yes
}

zin_tritons_refresh_seas = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_tritons_seas_init } }
		set_global_flag = zin_tritons_seas_init
		set_variable = { global.zin_tritons_piracy = 35 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_tritons_piracy > 59 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_tritons_sea_band = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_tritons_piracy > 24 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_tritons_sea_band = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { global.zin_tritons_sea_band = 0 } }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_tritons_islands }
		remove_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_open_lanes
		remove_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_harried_lanes
		remove_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_corsair_season
		remove_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_lean_season
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_tritons_chart_house }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_tritons_sea_band = 0 } } add_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_open_lanes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_tritons_sea_band = 2 } } add_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_harried_lanes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_tritons_corsair_haven }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_tritons_sea_band = 0 } } add_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_lean_season }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_tritons_sea_band = 2 } } add_ideas = zin_shared_tritons_islands_corsair_season }
		}
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_side (keyword chart 1, haven 2, none 3).
zin_tritons_set_side = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_side = 1 } } zin_tritons_set_side_chart = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_side = 2 } } zin_tritons_set_side_haven = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_side = 3 } } zin_tritons_set_side_none = yes }
}

zin_tritons_set_side_chart = {
	set_country_flag = zin_tritons_chart_house
	clr_country_flag = zin_tritons_corsair_haven
	zin_tritons_refresh_seas = yes
}

zin_tritons_set_side_haven = {
	set_country_flag = zin_tritons_corsair_haven
	clr_country_flag = zin_tritons_chart_house
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_faction = yes
			any_country = {
				has_country_flag = zin_tritons_charter_leader
				is_in_faction_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		leave_faction = yes
	}
	zin_tritons_refresh_seas = yes
}

zin_tritons_set_side_none = {
	clr_country_flag = zin_tritons_chart_house
	clr_country_flag = zin_tritons_corsair_haven
	zin_tritons_refresh_seas = yes
}

zin_tritons_found_charter = {
	create_faction_from_template = zin_faction_pupor_charter
	set_global_flag = zin_tritons_charter_founded
	set_country_flag = zin_tritons_charter_leader
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_side = 1 }
	zin_tritons_set_side = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_region_tritons_islands
			has_country_flag = zin_tritons_charter_invited
			is_in_faction = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_tritons_corsair_haven }
		}
		PREV = { add_to_faction = PREV }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
	zin_tritons_add_piracy = yes
}

zin_tritons_join_charter = {
	random_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_tritons_charter_leader }
		country_event = zin_shared_tritons_islands.2
	}
}

zin_tritons_offer_banks_mediation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = NND
		}
		NND = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_tritons_mediation_accepted
					}
				}
				country_event = zin_shared_tritons_islands.3
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = SEI
		}
		SEI = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_tritons_mediation_accepted
					}
				}
				country_event = zin_shared_tritons_islands.3
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_tritons_accept_mediation = {
	set_country_flag = zin_tritons_mediation_accepted
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_tritons_both_accepted = yes
		}
		zin_tritons_make_banks_accord = yes
	}
}

zin_tritons_refuse_mediation = {
	FROM = {
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = ROOT
			modifier = zin_tritons_mediation_refused
		}
	}
}

zin_tritons_make_banks_accord = {
	set_global_flag = zin_tritons_banks_accord
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_tritons_is_nondondor = yes }
		remove_ideas = zin_regional_nondondor_the_contested_banks
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_tritons_is_seite_islands = yes }
			remove_opinion_modifier = {
				target = PREV
				modifier = zin_tritons_banks_quarrel
			}
			PREV = {
				remove_opinion_modifier = {
					target = PREV
					modifier = zin_tritons_banks_quarrel
				}
			}
			diplomatic_relation = {
				country = PREV
				relation = non_aggression_pact
				active = yes
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -3 }
	zin_tritons_add_piracy = yes
}

zin_tritons_join_crossing = {
	var:global.zin_west_convener = { add_to_faction = PREV }
	random_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
			has_war_with = var:global.zin_west_convener
		}
		PREV = {
			add_to_war = {
				targeted_alliance = var:global.zin_west_convener
				enemy = PREV
				hostility_reason = asked_to_join
			}
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = zin_tritons_with_the_crossing
}
